column1: # Colour and opacity of the enchant glow, per enchant LEVEL.
# Written into system\env.int by tools\client\patch_env_enchant.ps1 -Table : the client reads the
# row by the glow code the server sends (model/item/EnchantGlow.java), and every code 0..127 gets
# the row of the level it stands for. See docs/enchant-glow.md.
# Opacity multiplies the Opacity of every emitter of the EnchantGlow effect - 1 is the effect as
# baked, 0.5 half as bright ; 0 or less the client turns into 0.001. Num goes to
# AEmitter::SetMaxParticles. R1..B2 tint only the retail aura mesh (hero weapons), not EnchantGlow.
# Levels past +43 are drawn as +43 (the code is a byte of at most 127). A level left out takes the
# row of the nearest level below it. Below +4 nothing glows, whatever the row says.
# level  R1   G1   B1   R2   G2   B2   Opacity  Num
